input.description: Information based on which the price was calculated.

sourceLocation.description: Country for which the provided price was originally defined.

sourceTaxClass.description: Tax class originally applied to the provided price.

targetLocation.description: Country for which the price was calculated.

targetTaxClass.description: Tax class that was applied when calculating the price.

includesTax.description:
Flag indicating whether the price provided in the request was expressed as net or gross.

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `true` | Prices will be expressed as gross values. |
| `false` | Prices will be expressed as net values. |

sourceTaxRate.description: Tax rate originally applied to the provided price.

targetTaxRate.description: Tax rate that was applied when calculating the price.

countryCode.description: Code of the country for which the tax classes are specified, as defined in the Country Service.
